hooks.name: Security Gate on Save (python-security-agent)
hooks.description: On saving a Python file, asks Kiro to check security using the python-security-agent.

action.prompt: Using the python-security-agent, review the security of the file I just saved and any files changed versus HEAD. Keep it quick: report only new issues introduced (file:line + severity + fix) and end with the SECURITY_GATE verdict.
